features.name: Linux Codex Desktop app path detection
whiteBoxChecks: Installer selftest reads snippet manifest and patch attachments
blackBoxChecks: In an AlmaLinux minimal container, install accepts a codex-app root containing start.sh and version
The installed launcher resolves the configured codex-app path without patching Codex Desktop files

features.name: CDP injection into the primary Linux webview target
whiteBoxChecks: Regression test covers multi-target CDP selection
blackBoxChecks: Launch Codex Desktop through Codex++ and verify the main Codex page receives injected controls
Verify hotkey or secondary windows are not selected ahead of the main conversation window

features.name: Linux launcher environment and helper access
whiteBoxChecks: Regression tests cover resolver and proxy environment preservation
blackBoxChecks: Codex starts from the Codex++ Manager without Cannot access before initialization errors
The Codex webview can call the Codex++ helper over localhost without private-network preflight failure

features.name: Linux entrypoint install and health detection
whiteBoxChecks: Regression tests cover Linux install roots and desktop entries
blackBoxChecks: Overview health check reports static launch entry and management tool entry as present
Created desktop files use upstream-style Codex++ names and descriptions

features.name: Pure API profile synchronization
whiteBoxChecks: Regression tests cover config.toml updates when active API profile changes
blackBoxChecks: Switching API profiles in Codex++ rewrites $HOME/.codex/config.toml
Codex Desktop launched through Codex++ observes the selected BaseURL and API key

features.name: Plugins navigation unlock
whiteBoxChecks: Renderer injection contains plugin navigation unlock logic
blackBoxChecks: The Plugins entry is clickable in the Linux Codex Desktop sidebar
The Plugins label does not show temporary Unlocked debug suffixes

features.name: Plugin detail response normalization
whiteBoxChecks: Regression tests cover plugin detail payload normalization
blackBoxChecks: Opening a marketplace plugin detail page does not jump to an error page
Plugin install and detail pages both work after relaunch

features.name: Injected delete conversation controls do not refresh the app
whiteBoxChecks: Renderer tests cover delete button event handling
Renderer injection prevents full page refresh for injected delete controls
blackBoxChecks: Deleting a conversation from the injected control does not show the Codex splash reload
Codex++ injection remains active after delete actions

features.name: Fast service-tier control in Linux composer footer
blackBoxChecks: When Fast mode is enabled in Codex++ Manager, the Fast badge appears in the Codex composer footer
The Fast badge remains clickable during transient backend-checking states

features.name: Codex Context Used Meter marketplace user script
blackBoxChecks: Install and enable Codex Context Used Meter from the script market
After launching Codex Desktop through Codex++ Manager, the context meter appears in the conversation UI

features.name: Interactive and non-interactive install/update/uninstall cycle
whiteBoxChecks: Installer selftest succeeds with isolated HOME
Installer source and installed binary marker checks pass
blackBoxChecks: AlmaLinux minimal container validates non-interactive install, update, and uninstall
